title: Graceful cascade for loading/disabled button clusters and theme-aware fallbacks
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Problem: Multiple product teams report visual jitter and confusing state transitions when adjacent action buttons enter loading/disabled states (e.g., Submit->Confirm, Row actions in tables). Current spinner placement and token usage cause layout shift and inconsistent hit targets in dark theme and compact density. This ticket standardizes a "graceful cascade" pattern: progressive shimmer/spinner entry, token-defined spacing to avoid layout shift, and a fallback spinner-only compact for constrained widths. The work includes token updates (spacing and spinner size), icon-button hit target fixes, theme-aware color swaps, and a small a11y sweep to ensure screen readers announce state changes predictably.
acceptance_criteria: New cascade animation is documented in Figma and implemented in the component spec
No layout shift on button loading state across compact/regular densities (measured via lab: CLS < 0.01 for component examples)
Icon-only buttons maintain 44px tap target in all densities and themes
Dark and high-contrast themes have distinct spinner color tokens and pass contrast checks (WCAG 2.1 AA)
Unit visual tests added (Percy/Chromatic) and PR merged with design sign-off
Regression checklist executed against 10 representative screens; no visual regressions remain
decisions: Prefer CSS-based cascade (staggered opacity/transform) over JS choreography to keep runtime cost low and avoid bundling new animation libraries
Use token 'button.loading-gap' to reserve inline spacing rather than collapsing layout; fallback to spinner-only for widths < 96px
Spinner color tokens: 'spinner.on-surface' (light) and 'spinner.on-surface-dark' (dark) to avoid runtime color inversion hacks
Icon-only hit target enforced with an invisible padding token 'button.icon-padding' to preserve visual density but keep 44px target
Avoid auto-focus on loading buttons to prevent unexpected scroll jumps; preference to visible focus outline on keyboard tab
